notes.title: 28.17: Last Patch of 2024!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve released a small patch before the new year with a few updates and fixes:

[b]Improved Bots:[/b] Bots now come with a variety of decks, adding more diversity and challenge when playing against them.
[b]Starter Set Availability:[/b] The Starter Set is now a one-time purchase with no time limit.
Connection Error Logs: Added logging for connection errors to help prevent endless loading issues in the future.
[b]Hotfixes:[/b] Addressed few issues reported by players.
Thank you for your continued support, and we wish you a very Happy New Year! 🎉

— The Comico Team

notes.title: End-of-Year Update Version 28.16: AI, Optimization, and More
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

As 2024 draws to a close, we’re thrilled to bring you an exciting update for ScreenPlay CCG!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/742f7ec0bfc331f0f17e53d98d99840ff83c6707.jpg[/img]

[h2]New AI[/h2]
Our bots have leveled up! Matches with AI opponents are now smarter and more engaging, making every game more fun and challenging.

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
We heard your feedback loud and clear. This patch includes significant optimization improvements, ensuring smoother gameplay across the board. If you still encounter issues, please let us know on Discord – your input helps us improve!

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new art assets.
[*] Improved match loading animations.
[*] Adjusted narrative sound effects for better balance.
[*] Starter Set and Starter Bundle are available in the Store as one-time high-value purchases
[/list]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
We’re already working on the next small patch, followed by a larger update featuring in-game tournaments and a draft mode to add more variety to the competition. Stay tuned for updates!

From all of us at Comico Games, we wish you a very Merry Christmas and happy holidays! 🎄

notes.title: New Patch Update: Performance Boosts and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey Directors!

We know some of you encountered performance issues and a few bugs in the last patch. Thanks for your feedback—it helped us shape this new patch, which includes:

[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay Performance Improvements[/b]
We heard reports about slow and laggy performance, so we worked on a big improvement. Let us know if it feels smoother or if you still notice any issues.

[*] [b]Matchmaking Notification[/b]
You can now have matchmaking active while multitasking. A sound notification will alert you when a match is ready.

[*] [b]"Skip Debut" Button in Settings[/b]
For those who’d like to jump right into competitive mode, you can now skip the Cinematic Debut campaign in Settings. Perfect for you seasoned filmmakers ready to dive into the action!

[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*] BloodBeard quest sticking on the screen (thanks, MageArmour!)
[*] Lone Ranger crash (thanks to Azurah Star for reporting)
[/list]

We have another patch coming soon, and as always, your feedback is invaluable! Please share your experience with us on Discord.

Thanks for helping us make ScreenPlay CCG better!

notes.title: Pre-Winter Premiere: Major Update Now Live
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, Movie Directors![/h1]

We’re thrilled to announce the [b]Pre-Winter Premiere[/b]—a new patch packed with updates and improvements. It took us a bit longer to get this version out, but we believe it’ll be worth the wait!

[h2]Improved Tutorial Experience[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/fd37de8df84312a1e056cfa144d191b074449237.png[/img]
As a new game, we want to ensure that all players can easily dive in and enjoy. We’ve reworked the tutorial based on tons of feedback to make it more accessible. You’ll find better pacing, voiced lines, and a softer, more digestible presentation of mechanics. These enhancements aim to make learning the game clearer and more enjoyable—perfect for newcomers and those still deciding.

[h2]Introducing PvE Story Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/7501553996e4410eddbffd29479ff0d537d4cbb9.png[/img]
Instead of jumping straight from the tutorial to practice or multiplayer, you can now test your skills in our new PvE story campaign. Play against improved bots and enjoy a narrative-driven experience with generous rewards. The campaign provides enough resources to craft at least two additional leads beyond the starter deck, which offers even more ways to experiment with team combinations. We’ve also added guides for deckbuilding, crafting, and missions to support your journey as a budding movie director in ScreenPlay.

[h2]Daily Missions UI Overhaul[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/2812e47ef521ca32000f40e0029433f51eb47c87.png[/img]
You spoke, and we listened! We’ve redesigned the daily missions UI based on player feedback, making it easier to track and claim rewards. We hope this change makes your daily quests more enjoyable and fulfilling.

[h2]Enhanced Rank Badges[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/82018d55fc4689008347712f064e3d65ecf47184.png[/img]
Our previous rank badges were placeholders, but this update brings a visual upgrade. We want you to feel proud of your rank and enjoy showcasing your directorial prowess. While they may see further refinement, we hope you enjoy the new look.

[h2]Match Reconnection Feature[/h2]
We’re introducing a match reconnection feature, allowing you to resume matches in case of crashes, disconnections, or desyncs. This ensures a smoother and more reliable gameplay experience, so you can stay focused on directing your masterpiece.

[h2]Bot Improvements[/h2]
The bots have been improved to provide a fun experience, especially for new players. They now offer a good challenge up to the first 2-3 ranks, helping players sharpen their skills.

[h2]Early Match Emotes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/f1f5a9f1ac22326767179d5c920d7de379225c72.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/8ebd10dd12551a53666ce7650d0897b2fff29873.png[/img]
Players can now send default emote messages during matches. This is an early version of the feature, with more exciting emotes and customization options coming in future patches.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/0907d65d8eb4facfc6a2b4ba3c2a98c0eb294baf.png[/img]
[i]New vfx for Noir Thinking[/i]

This patch also includes upgrades to card art, VFX, and sound FX, with more enhancements planned for future updates. We’ve also addressed numerous bugs, with special thanks to our community for their helpful reports.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/ded86fc5e0d96e2bc8bfc098c2d652c0370ee552.png[/img]
In the coming patches, you can expect further bot improvements, new cards, a draft mode, in-game tournaments and one more special mode. Plus, we’re working on additional VFX, animations, and new card art to keep enhancing your experience.

We hope you enjoy this update! Spread the word, and let us know what you’d like to see in future patches. Thank you for being a part of ScreenPlay—we’re excited to have you with us on this journey!

notes.title: Version 28.11: rebalancing, optimizing, polishing
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, thanks for your patience with our patch! In this update, we’ve introduced game balances, a revamped collection system, new voiceovers and performance optimizations.
[h1]Game rebalance[/h1]
[h2]Base mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] If the card is frozen, its frames on the reel are considered "broken" (i.e. won't count for BBQ Bill)
[*] Performance interruption always steals 1 story point.
[/list]
[h2]Leads[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]BBQ Bill[/b]: +1 story arc, shattered action frames on reel are not counted for his ability, performance detection for his ability is now genre based.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/c139161aaa23df75b79b9b82ae41e031a3ed39a1.png[/img]
[*] [b]Insult Comic Frog[/b]: Gains 1 NP in the end of scene, and an extra NP for a successful performance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/072f7c9b70b75452e258ce7435c3a86fd348858f.png[/img]
[*] [b]The Godfish[/b]: +1 story arc,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/7e156c413726a2de4f09315f727adfd7445499b2.png[/img]
[*] [b]Qaal[/b]: now have 2 attack and 6 HP,  -1 story arc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/f048c8952cd9b19cd25c55bd2bd065908d3daf8b.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Characters[/h2]
[expand]
[list]
[*] Sleight-of-hand Heister: Now returns to hand on successfull attack, dodge or performance.
[*] BIRD-E: Bounty is now 1, got Unstoppable, attacks on second frame out of 3.
[*] Sacrificial Goat: Triggered only when killed by friendly, no other conditions.
[*] Chillodile: Triggers if damaged in the end of scene, no other conditions.
[*] Bureaucrat Leech: Several leeches can not steal the same NP now.
[*] Mind Control Operative: Played on first out of two frames now.
[*] Counterfeiter Cuttlefish: Free 6 NP from your lead on set.
[*] Jumbo Dumbo: Attack freeze is 2, on enter freeze is 2.
[*] Doomed Augur: Triggered only when killed by friendly.
[*] Pengnum P.I.: 2 HP, counting only friendly.
[*] Baby Cthulhu: 4/4, costs 2, freezes by 2.
[*] Remote-controlled Popstar: Steals 1 NP.
[*] Meathead Rebel: 5 HP, attack costs 2.
[*] Eco-Friendly Bog Monster: 3/3 stats now.
[*] Raptor Boys: Raptors are 2/1 stats now.
[*] Pro-Profit Centurion: 4 HP.
[*] Brainwashing Machine: 1/5 stats now.
[*] Rocky Reef Plankton: 1/2 stats now.
[*] Debt-Ridden Scholar: 2/1 stats now.
[*] Inspector Incognito: 1/6 stats now.
[*] Cousin Caiman: 3/4 stats now.
[*] Judge Dairy: 5 HP.
[*] Vaxxinut: 1/2 stats now.
[/list]
[/expand]
[h2]Crew[/h2]
[expand]
[list]
[*] Dynamator: Play costs 2 frames, ability costs 2 frames.
[*] Obsessive Assistant: Ability costs 1 frame.
[*] Adventure Ashington: Play costs 1 frame.
[*] Unstable Clapper: Play costs 1 frame.
[*] Sci-Fi Siri: Ability costs 1 frame.
[*] Reel Runner: Ability costs 1 frame.
[*] Monster Maker: Play costs 2 frames.
[*] Action Axel: Ability to 2 frames.
[*] Horror Hank: Ability to 1 frame.
[/list]
[/expand]
[h2]Tropes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Couch Trap: Freeze pre-selected enemy lead backstage to no more than 3.
[*] Trap Door: Play costs 2 frames.
[/list]

[b]Players will receive automatic compensation on their account for any nerfed cards in their collection. [/b]

Thanks to all community members involved in playtesting the changes: JetmanSkye, MageArmour, Aqwijn, Merxy, yarracteeln.

[h1]More Voiceovers[/h1]
We added voiceover for tons of characters - Rex Xaah, The Godfish, Bartender Hydra, Alice Alea and many more.

[h1]The Great Collection Schism[/h1]
By popular demand, we've revamped the way you view your Collection! Now, Decks and Cards are separate entities with their own screens.
[list]
[*] [b]New Collection Screen[/b]: Easily view your Collection on a dedicated screen.
[*] [b]Updated Deck Selection Screen[/b]: The decklist now exclusively serves as a decklist, with all deck actions performed at the center of the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/7397ff487681182c2624b310a02eb4ff4c0d3737.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Color Indication for Missing Cards[/b]: Cards not in your Collection are now clearly indicated with color.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/b83c91a6203d78f67811fbde28801fac3bb8ce03.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Improved Crafting Access[/b]: The crafting window now appears automatically when you add a card not in your Collection. More convenient ways to mass craft cards are on the way!
[/list]

[h1]Performance optimization[/h1]
[list]
We’re excited to announce significant performance improvements in our latest update! For the first time since our early access release, we've made major strides in optimizing the game.
[list]
[*] [b]Faster Load Times[/b]: Enjoy significantly reduced load times.
[*] [b]Improved Memory Management[/b]: The game now uses a more predictable amount of memory.
[*] [b]Smoother Visuals[/b]: Experience a smoother and more polished gameplay experience.
[/list]
While we’re not claiming perfection just yet, these enhancements provide a solid foundation for future optimizations. Thank you for your continued support as we work to make the game even better!
[/list]

notes.title: Version 28.7 Game Update
notes.notes:
Hey.

We collected some user feedback and fixed few pretty critical, even blocking problems.

[h2]Display support[/h2]
We've implemented basic support for beyond 1080p and aspect ratios outside of 16:9. Although the interface placement during the tutorial previously blocked progress, these issues have been corrected. The visuals may vary with different displays, and we plan to enhance this in future updates.

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
Feedback revealed that the tutorial was not effective for everyone, which is crucial for a game where understanding the rules is important. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/5aa0af3c3d755262fb66518671660aa97f4471b2.jpg[/img]

We've added reminders and rebalanced the tutorial decks to improve clarity and flow. Further refinements are scheduled for the next patch.

[h2]Localization [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3c56c43081a9e3c5693f4b0ef3f7961c9b0089dd.jpg[/img]

We've laid the groundwork for adding multiple languages to the game. During this process, we encountered issues with font rendering, which may affect text quality for some, though it might not be noticeable to everyone. We now support partial translations (lore and some elements might still be in English) in:
[list]
[*] German
[*] Japanese
[*] Portuguese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] French
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new sound for a lot of things: victory, defeat, pack opening, etc.
[*] Fixed Cybocock not gaining story points when a backfire character attacked Cybochick (thanks, NatriOn for report!).
[*] Fixed BBQ BIll without spotlight end of scene triggering before the one with spotlight
[*] Improved layour of missions UI. We will be re-designing and improving it further so expect more updates on that in next patches.
[*]Fixed some cryptic UI and gameplay related-crashes.
[/list]

[h2]Artwork Attribution[/h2]
In previous versions of the game, the names of artists and AI-generated artwork were only noted in the lore section, which led to some confusion about transparency. To clarify, we have now extended this attribution to the collection section as well. All placeholder artwork includes a visible watermark when you hover over the cards in both the collection and lore sections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/1c33c7894561fc37a6b9402e06f70ca14b22f866.jpg[/img]

We want to assure you that AI-generated artwork is used strictly as temporary placeholders, and we are actively replacing them with original pieces created by our talented artists. For a deeper insight into our creative process, please check out our post titled '[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1830700/view/4195743270538007528]The Art of ScreenPlay.[/url]'


Thank you all for your continued support. We look forward to sharing more updates soon.

notes.title: Version 28.5: Get ready to jump into Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting News, Everyone![/h2]
This is our final patch before we make the big leap to Early Access tomorrow. We're thrilled about this milestone and hope you are too. Here’s what you can expect in this last update before the big day:

[h3]"Chain" missions[/h3]
Embark on thrilling multistage missions to earn more goldies and unlock new rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/bc576ec2f5b863f158c615e99f69e68764764de4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Voiceover for tutorial[/h3]
We've introduced a voiceover in the tutorial! It's not fully polished yet, but it’s there to enhance the experience for new players. Expect further improvements in upcoming patches.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/6e9b25ad5434b016370556a57373749b948a69a2.png[/img]

[h3]New artwork[/h3]
Check out the fresh artwork for these cards: Ocean D. Finley, Archimimus, Alien Abduction, Firebrand Lassie, Clumsy Cactus, and Jurassic Canon Fodder. Thanks to our awesome artists for bringing these characters to life with their illustrations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/26949dee3328cba5dd8c506dcdb1cb720aea6369.png[/img]

[h3]New Movie Sets: [/h3]
Explore genre-themed movie sets now available in the store:
[list]
[*] Comedy: Dive into hilarious mix-ups at a fun fair.
[*] Mystery: Solve a bank robbery gone wrong with secret shadows lurking.
[*] Drama: Ramp up the telenovela tension in a wealthy family's estate.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3de5ddb07dba0cdd90c667cbb4b86bf0f3a11c7a.png[/img]

[h3]New Card Backs: [/h3]
We've added a variety of new card backs and other exciting goodies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/2faa59c9bdbaa5f0b6e7ce3aeb0104cf5d028128.png[/img]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added non-animated version of Sly, adjusted cost of animated Sly to be in line with other animated directors.
[*] CyboBoy and Bartender Hydra would not freeze from their planned attack, if they have been already frozen (thanks, @Dunkoro).
[*] After mass effects characters won't get stuck under each other and move to proper position on the set right away (thanks, @kramushka and friends).
[*] When you steal narrative points from opponent, your Sleight of hand trickster won't return back to your hand (thanks, @Majstor).
[*] If character under Bloodbeards effect attacks and dies during an attack, it won't steal the narrative points.
[*] Fixed Spikes visuals alignment.
[*] Character with lethal has to deal attack damage for it to activate, Spikes and Backfire is not considered attack damage (thanks, @Dunkoro)
[*] Making copy of the deck won't overwrite already exist copy.
[*] When collecting large number of bounty points after AoE, they are properly spread between Lead and the free narrative points (thanks, @NatriOn).
[/list]

[h3]Looking Ahead:[/h3]
This release sets the stage for our early access launch tomorrow. Get ready, spread the word, and dive into the world of ScreenPlay, where creativity meets cinema. Calling all visionary directors to join us!

notes.title: ScreenPlay Update 28.4
notes.notes:
Hey Directors! We've been hard at work adding new enhancements, content, and bug fixes. There's plenty more on the way as we gear up for our Early Access launch in May 2024. Help us spread the word and invite more players to join in on the fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3938a08893b163a81d4c56f9faaa7ab02cbf6420.png[/img]

[h2]Enhancements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new UI for cards in zones such as the opponent's hand and Extras, designed for easier navigation, viewing, and selection of cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3ba024414ba1f662f77d334f81605f21b6e44481.gif[/img]
[*] Enhanced card pack opening animations now include an exciting reveal of each card, along with the ability to preview a large visual of the card once the pack is opened.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/5ec92b9262524e4bf190f5a90e2422c2c064dbe5.gif[/img]
[*] Removed redundant FX type filters from the Collection.
[*] Introduced the "Queenpin max out" animation – watch Queenpin in action!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/d715ba47a5a12da5a95366c63ff67ce89a38a9aa.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes: [/h2]
[list]
 [*] Corrected an issue in the tutorial where players were prompted to dodge before being shown how.
[*] Added missing spikes VFX.
[*] Fixed a bug where Totem Boy's aura was reapplying every time a new character came on set. (Thanks, @yarractheeln)

[*] Addressed an issue with extra characters performing due to Qaal; they will no longer perform if Qaal was removed from the set.
[*] The Undo button will not disappear correctly if you use Qaal's performance UI first. (Thanks, @toniemacaronie16 and @tougarashi3357)
[*] Resolved an issue where characters with the pack hunt keyword would perform an empty attack instead of dodging. (Thanks, @dunkoro )
[*] Fixed "Tag[*]in!" to disallow another character from the hand to play if the selected character is not present on set when "Tag[*]in!" is used.
[*] Fixed several issues with narrative sound, including potential duplication and volume control problems. (Thanks, @yarractheeln )
[*] Addressed text cut[*]off issues in the Collection search bar.
[*] Fixed misalignment issues in Illuminati Lizard and Roast Comic Frog max out animations. (Thanks, @n4trion)
[*] Corrected the "Performances Interrupted" mission to work correctly with different sources of interruption. (Thanks, @toaster404. )
[*] Resolved the Laugh Bot crash issue. (Thanks, @dunkoro)
[*] Fixed various other minor bugs and crashes.
[/list]

Additional Note: [i]The star of the 2001 movie Exit Wounds, Steven Seagal, a noted aficionado of carrot cake, had absolutely nothing to do with this update. Any rumors of his involvement are entirely unfounded and should be dismissed.[/i]

notes.title: Version 27.7 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the game's full-screen mode to be borderless.
[*] Fixed a bug where Jaw-Z broke the rules of narrative collecting, reported by member of our community server [b]toaster404[/b].
[*] Fixed the problem of interaction between character abilities and stolen narrative, reported by member of our community server [b]Xekon#8266[/b].
[*] Fixed few crashed related to the user interface.
[*] Corrected the description of Pro-Profit Centurion and his legionnaires, thanks to our community server member [b]yarractheeln[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/faa64f2af278329259e6122737cfe61c3f2f4316.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Addressing a Notorious Crash[/h1]
The persistent [i]"Unable to get variable res from object XXXX"[/i] error has been a major point of discussion. Our gratitude goes out to [b]toaster404 [/b]and [b]Kram[/b] for their detailed reports. 

This issue was traced back to the game engine. We have [url=https://github.com/YoYoGames/GameMaker-Bugs/issues/3929]reported this to the engine developers[/url] and they've acknowledged it as a bug.

Currently, we've implemented a temporary fix. A complete resolution will follow with an upcoming engine update. A big thank you to our community for helping us identify these issues and for your continued patience.

notes.title: Happy New Year! Update 27.6 Released
notes.notes:
Season's Greetings, movie directors! Our latest update brings you a sleigh-load of improvements.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[b]Say goodbye to the freezing issue in the tutorial, and thanks for flagging it![/b]

Plus, we've ironed out several gameplay bugs, particularly those tricky corner cases.

[h1]Cards rebalancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Roast Comic Frog lead now gains 2 Narrative Points at the start of a scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/3ec317ab2dda9d652e323195df37524c7156ad6c.jpg[/img]

[*] Jaw-Z lead now gains 2 Narrative Points for a successful performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/c716b6797f4615584f4adb35649787ac1f8d68ee.jpg[/img]

[*] Pro-Profit Centurion character now enters on the 4th frame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/87176beec9893b3bc13bc5f57c8ae09a5abc920d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Matchmaking tuning[/h1]
To enhance your gaming experience, our matchmaking system initially tries to find you a fellow player for a few minutes. During this wait, you'll see a pop-up offering two choices: either jump into a game with a bot or keep waiting for a real player. You also have the option to team up with a friend. If a player match isn't found after a certain period, the system might pair you with a bot for that round, but will try for a real player in the next. To make the most of your experience, we encourage you to invite friends to join the game. Playing with friends not only makes the game more enjoyable but also helps build our community. Plus, check out our Discord for PvP hours to play when our player base is most active.

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
We've added some visual flair to the game. Enjoy the new flat turtle animation, plus fireworks for the victory screen!
[previewyoutube=3e7qSv02Nq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Deckbuilding[/h1]
We're gradually introducing more intricate rules:

This update adds deckbuilding guidelines:
[list]
[*] Minimum 40 cards in a deck;
[*] Include 2 or 3 lead cards;
[*] Leads' genres dictate other card genres;
[*] Amount of copies is determined by each card's rarity (number of dots in bottom left corner).
[center][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/d9caecb9544df475659ec07c11771e55faee220d.jpg[/img][/center]
[center][i]Up to three copies for Bartender Hydra, four for Ben Bones' Edits.[/i][/center]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/092ddc489eaddac8e293a46a83b2a612e5a7cb6f.jpg[/img]
Heads up: Your deck might need some tweaking to comply with the new rules. We've updated our preconstructed decks accordingly. Happy building!

notes.title: Hotfix 27.5
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who played with their favorite streamers in the past days, and, of course, thanks to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/amazonian]Amazonian[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/derajn]DeraJN[/url]  themselves. You've highlighted several issues.

[list]
[*] The order of interaction is no longer broken when units enter the set. For example, Maximus could share the set with another lead for some time.
[*] Lead animation no longer plays on the backstage if they complete a story arc through receiving a free narrative.
[*] Simultaneous entry of units into a set (for example, with Pro-profit Centurion) if there is Firearm Fanatic on the set will no longer cause problems.
[*] Fixed potential bot softlock.
[*] Minor text correction for BIRD-E.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 27.3
notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: Update 27.2 Rolls Out
notes.notes:
After closely observing the initial reactions and feedback from our streaming community, we've implemented some practical changes to enhance the gameplay. Here are the details:

[list]
[h1]New features[/h1]

[h3]Gameplay Timer[/h3]
To prevent lengthy turns and maintain the flow of the game, a timer has been added that caps the duration of player actions during a turn. This is a staple in many CCGs, and we're glad to integrate it into our game as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/c6c73274da93aba4ce6432b33a41e8ddf4c72599.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]New Scene Indicator[/h3]
To improve gameplay clarity, we've added a simple animation that signals the start of a new scene, where players can play cards and make moves such as attacks, dodges, or performances.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/cd7776e45db746d1dbe642b7677e3ab2f5895e75.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Combo Mechanics UI and VFX[/h3]
We've added tooltips and new visual effects to help you track combo checklists on certain cards more easily. These features will notify you clearly when a combo is successfully activated following the designated actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/4708a854001cd93e630553d0a26cdd9baa64c94e.jpg[/img]

Also, when you hover over a card with a combo mechanic, the combo checklist will now appear on the left side, simplifying the process of tracking the combo status of that card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/380d425049df5d1409ac2dd2ae3be44b43626119.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[*] [b]Card Artwork Loading: [/b]The artwork on cards should now load correctly every time, without any hitches.
[*] [b]General Gameplay Smoothness:[/b] We've worked on the backend to reduce the occasional game slowdowns, offering a more fluid gaming experience.
[*] [b]Camera Shift Bug Resolved:[/b] Addressed an issue where the camera would randomly shift during a match, providing a steadier visual experience.
[*] [b]Tutorial Bugs Fixed: [/b]Ironed out several bugs in the tutorial for a smoother introduction to the game.
[/list]

We appreciate your ongoing support and are constantly working to refine your gaming experience.

Happy movie-making!

notes.title: New ScreenPlay Version: The Ultimate Director's Cut
notes.notes:
Hello @everyone!

We're absolutely thrilled to usher you into the grand screening of new version of ScreenPlay. Much like an epic movie with its most exciting plot unveiled post-intermission, this new version is back in full swing and ready to steal the limelight. Imagine the ambiance: the house lights go down, the screen lights up, and the curtains pull back to reveal a blockbuster update.

[previewyoutube=lCSGVUD5-6g;full]ScreenPlay Game Trailer[/previewyoutube]

[h2]UI Visual Enhancement[/h2]

In our latest update, we've refreshed various facets of the game. Your captivating leads shine brighter in-game and out, while our streamlined interface ensures top-tier directing, both on set and behind the scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/aeb98eec1999fbaddc1288ea9adf0e2cb5143c12.png[/img]

[h2]Explore the Lore[/h2]

It's a fresh era in cinematic magic! Out with the old props cluttering your home screen, in with our revamped Lore Screen - a filmmaker's haven. Dive into the rich lore of your favorite films

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/b05c00e8d7f2b13e2c08e1d472bcd38c2b790f3c.png[/img]

[h2]Revamped Deck Building[/h2]

or piece together your directorial masterpiece with our updated deck builder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/45e30f6fd742853096496a7f1a9b391f63156e93.png[/img]

[h2]New Surf Rock Theme[/h2]

Savor the realm of your artistry, pausing to appreciate the redesigned card frames. To enhance the ambiance, enjoy the mesmerizing score from acclaimed composer, George Sanger (Wing Commander! Maniac Mansion!).

With its promise of a unique cinematic experience, we believe you'll love this update as much as we do! Grab your popcorn, take your director's seat, and let's roll. Action!

[h2]New Rewarding Lead Animations[/h2]

Like any blockbuster, we've spiced things up with a few surprises! Brace yourself for the reveal of your set's striking new visuals. Our Leads, eager since our last version, now take center stage with spectacular animations in every scene. Behold as your Leads command the spotlight with dynamic animations and captivating narratives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/c1dfefcefffdce4df2e00387b63d4fede22c9ca2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/186814f8b92ddb1cf20f3dfcd66655aa740d0e54.gif[/img]

[h2]New Immersive Film Sets[/h2]

To complement our dynamic Leads, we've reimagined our game boards into lively, interactive sets that sync with the drama of your movie.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/fea36c48f62a121cda55ecaf2f8e7f59ad64a6e8.gif[/img]

[h2]Interactive Characters Upgrade[/h2]

Surrounding your Leads is a vibrant cast, adding charm and humor to your filmmaking journey. Engage with each character on your board and witness the VFX upgrade, making your cherished cards sparkle with revamped special effects.

[h2]Gameplay UI Overhaul[/h2]

We've also streamlined the Gameplay UI, equipped with narrative bars, functional frames, quick-access arrows, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/4e2eace3a5b2328434ea12b166bad7e85ab955a4.gif[/img]

[h2]New Genre-Driven Gameplay Music[/h2]

But the enhancements aren't just visual! Thanks to George Sanger's skilled audio team, immersive battle music and sound effects will transport you straight to your bustling movie set.

[h2]New Versus Screen[/h2]

Ready for a sneak peek at your opponent? Our new versus splash has got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/254ae5b941ad09648aa1a6dbfae7d00a5ecc62c9.png[/img]

[h2]New Victory/Defeat Screen[/h2]

And prepare for the thrill of seeing your name in lights or the bittersweet taste of a less-than-stellar review when your film's run ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/63e88a7ad1604b0e42a16744f1b14fd06344516c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/2a0730912504b3bd8c8d879c19f671f0c3e80acd.png[/img]

[h2]Tutorial Improvement[/h2]

We've acted on your feedback, revamping the tutorial for a clearer, smoother introduction to the game. Also, anticipate game-enhancing modifications as we refine and expand our core set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/4d88514d1ad5c0a73fa6666221f81724ddfe8850.png[/img]

[h2]Reduced Lead Cooldowns[/h2]

Our experiments revealed that our Leads prefer action over negotiation. So, expect them on screen more frequently and earlier than before, with both initial and freeze cooldowns significantly reduced.

[h2]Exciting New Cards[/h2]

Now, what's a premier without a showstopper, right? Indeed, no collectible card game update would be complete without fresh cards, and our creative workshop has been bustling. This version unveils the first batch of these much-awaited new arrivals, and rest assured, there's more in the pipeline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41622509/736173117414d556a58cb72f7ea60643a67b15c6.png[/img]

[h2]Full Hand Mechanics[/h2]

While we enjoyed the strategic gameplay of selecting frames and drawing cooldowns, we're moving to a more traditional drawing approach.

[h2]Rock-Paper-Scissors Gameplay Twist[/h2]

The core guessing game and rock-paper-scissors elements are more engaging when tropes and effects are decided during the planning phase, like Attacks. Say goodbye to surprise bovine onslaughts! We're also refining how the basic actions - Attack, Dodge, and Perform - interact for the most exciting films.

[h2]Tweaked Performance Interruption[/h2]

With this new version, we've tweaked 'performance interruption mechanics'. Now, only hitting or incapacitating the actual performer interrupts a performance, a change from the previous rules.

[h2]VFX Updates[/h2]

We've added plenty of new VFX and improved game performance. If you experience lag or performance issues, don't hesitate to let us know.

Grab your director's hat and settle into your chair – it's time to start creating your next blockbuster! We can't wait to see the magic you'll make with this new release. Remember, this is your story to tell. As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. Please share your experiences, thoughts, and suggestions, because in this game, every voice counts. Here's to crafting unforgettable narratives together – Lights, camera, action!
